_about: Known-bad citations as they stand in the reviewed prototype (ACCURACY-LEDGER.md). `check_figures.py --must-fire` extracts each from the HTML at `rev` and requires it to FAIL: proof the gate can fire (EVAL-DOCTRINE rule 1). One case per defect class. Never 'fix' a case here; add one when a new class of defect is found.

cases.class: a figure from a news article cited to an issuer page (Sahi p.2, cited as FS4 p.6)
a broker's figure riding on an issuer citation (Investec via Upstox p.3, cited as Q1D p.19)
a citation to the exchange cover letter (AR26 p.1) instead of the page that prints it (p.30)
an annual-report printed folio used as a PDF page (Infosys AR26 'p.318')
